result.rationale: The diff newly adds `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } })` in EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents and a similar DB fetch in handleCancelBooking, with no check that the credential belongs to the booking organizer/hosts — previously only this.calendarCredentials (already scoped to the event's users) were used. The mechanism (fetching credentials by raw ID without ownership validation) is verifiable in the diff; actual exploitability depends on data flow I can't fully verify from the diff.
